title: Approved Thermal Decomposition and Constant-Mass Evidence
learningGoal: Execute a teacher-approved carbonate-mixture plan with a configured sample mass, tare convention, heating/cooling limits, and replicate decision; acquire and separately record same-balance mass evidence, establish constant mass, derive composition, and preserve recovery provenance.

commonMistakes.when: heating is attempted with the lid fully seated
commonMistakes.message: A fully seated lid can trap evolved gas and be ejected.
commonMistakes.recovery: Turn off the burner and leave a visible vent gap before heating.

commonMistakes.when: the crucible is placed on the balance before cooling
commonMistakes.message: Hot apparatus can damage the balance and produce biased readings.
commonMistakes.recovery: Use tongs, cool at the approved location, then read the locked balance.

commonMistakes.when: constant mass is claimed from one cooled reading
commonMistakes.message: Constant mass requires two consecutive cooled readings within the approved tolerance.
commonMistakes.recovery: Repeat the full heat, extinguish, cool, read, and record sequence.
